title: Glowworm of his lamp.
html_source:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4-0lczIvkMI

From a song by Thomas Moore and a reference to Nestor, Ulysses Ch. 2. Gifford and Ithaca (not in Gifford).

John Eglinton is, of course, John Eglinton not WK Magee. Joyce continues, in parody, to use his full name which isn’t his name.
